Completed the assigned reviser stage. The same native Goal was activated and completed; its activation and terminal responses are saved in the stage directory.

- [native-goal-terminal.json](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/A-F01-A1_A8/run/A-F01-A1_A8/stages/reviser/native-goal-terminal.json)

The report adjudicates all six SCW claims and every released-plan clause. It records the primary-source checks, including SQLite’s WAL durability and same-host limits, and CouchDB’s 3.5.3 fix inclusion and conflict-body retrieval conditions ([SQLite WAL](https://www.sqlite.org/wal.html), [SQLite synchronous settings](https://www.sqlite.org/pragma.html), [CouchDB 3.5 release notes](https://docs.couchdb.org/en/stable/whatsnew/3.5.html), [CouchDB conflict handling](https://docs.couchdb.org/en/stable/replication/conflicts.html)). No application tests, crash tests, prototypes, or benchmarks were run; the missing application repository and its callers/tests are recorded as an open integration input.
